summary: Tested Emergent Google login + allowed-list (Team access) + password login regression. Backend: 39/40 pytest pass (new file test_iter3_google_auth.py 9/9). Only failure is pre-existing brute-force lockout test which is flaky (~50%) due to IP-keyed lockout behind multi-replica ingress. Frontend: google-login-btn redirects to auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/dashboard -> Google accounts page; /dashboard#session_id=bogus shows auth-callback then /login with 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.'; password login, dashboard, logout, protected route redirect all work; Team access add (trim+lowercase), Enter key add, invalid toast, remove, save + reload persistence all work; other settings unchanged; Channels page loads. allowed_emails left empty after cleanup.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host (ingress pod IP, varies per request) -> 6th failed attempt returns 429 only ~50% of the time; also unrelated users behind same ingress IP share counters. Use first X-Forwarded-For IP (helper already exists near line 320) instead.

allowed_emails not validated/normalized server-side (no email format check, no lowercase/dedupe). Frontend validates, but API accepts any strings. Also clients omitting allowed_emails silently reset it to [].
g['email'] KeyError and httpx network errors (timeout/connect) are unhandled -> 500 instead of 401/502.

action_items: Fix lockout identifier to use client IP from X-Forwarded-For (flaky test_bruteforce_lockout)
Optional: validate/normalize allowed_emails in backend (EmailStr, lowercase, dedupe)
Optional: wrap Emergent session-data call in try/except and handle missing email -> 401
critical_code_review_comments: Removing an email from allowed_emails does not revoke existing 7-day JWTs of that Google user; current_user does not re-check allow list.
All Google users get role admin and can edit allowed_emails (including removing others) - acceptable per spec but worth noting.
Login error from AuthCallback is passed via router location.state; it persists on page refresh of /login (minor).
seed_data_creation: None persisted; test allowed emails were removed (list is empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real Google sign-in cannot be automated; only redirect and bogus-session paths tested. Run pytest with '-n 0' to disable xdist when debugging single tests (pytest.ini enables xdist).
rca of the issue: test_bruteforce_lockout flaky: server.py login() builds ident=f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. Behind K8s ingress, client.host is the ingress/proxy IP, which differs across replicas, so failed-attempt counters split across idents and the 6th attempt may not hit 5. Reproduce: run the test 3x with -n 0 -> 1 pass/2 fail. Mitigation: derive IP from X-Forwarded-For first entry.
